Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1988
PAKISTAN PENAL
CODE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
ACT II OF 1988
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Penal Code
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st March, 1988]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 20th
March, 1988, anti-As hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan Penal Code
(Amendment) Act, 1988.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
Amendment of section 125 Act
XLV of 1860.-----In the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), in section
125, the word "Asiatic" shall be omitted.

Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing. It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2.Amendment of section 125 Act
XLV of 1860.-----In the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), in section
